glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): phonetic 气 + semantic 米 (“rice”). Later borrowed meanings of “air, flow” from 气. The derivative 餼 refers to the original word. Compare 乞.
s_page_origin: Pictogram (象形): clouds flowing through the sky. In the oracle bone script, it was represented by three horizontal strokes, expressing the "feeling" of the sky. However, in order to avoid confusion with the number 三, 气 was changed to draw a small stroke from top to bottom. Its variant is 乞 and was later used to distinguish a phonetically borrowed meaning, "to beg". Semantically unrelated to 氣 and its variant 餼 due to a different meaning ("give food as a gift").
senses: [qì] gas (matter in an intermediate state between liquid and plasma)
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 氣; s_page_origin explains the simplified 气.
